title: schoenus armeria var. globifer
intro: Schoenus armeria var. globifer, commonly known as globular club-rush, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). The plant is used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Schoenus armeria var. globifer may include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
